answer.origin: NN, Inc. announcement (late June 2026, original day not stated) as reported by finance.yahoo.com on 2026-07-01; the source is a secondary media article, not a primary NN or NVIDIA document.
answer.note: Source claim: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it is adding 47 machine centers for liquid cooling production at its Wuxi, China plant, described as for NVIDIA AI data center racks, and said 100% of the new capacity is already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. NN also targeted US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026 from the expansion. What it supports about NVIDIA: it is a supply-chain lead, not a sales fact. A supplier's liquid-cooling capacity build aimed at NVIDIA rack programs suggests that NVIDIA-platform rack demand is pulling supplier capacity into Asia in 2026. The pre-sold claim is NN's own statement about its awards and does not show that NVIDIA is the direct buyer or the contract counterparty, and the source gives no NVIDIA order, volume, or price. The US$80-90 million figure is a company target for NN's revenue, not a measure of NVIDIA purchases. The analyst revenue and earnings projections, the fair value figures, the Russell index removal, and the promotional items are about NN's stock or valuation and do not inform NVIDIA's business, so they are not used.
limitations: The record does not identify the customers under NN's multi-year, multi-product awards, so the NVIDIA link rests on the article's framing of the plant as serving NVIDIA rack programs.
The 100% pre-sold claim is NN's own statement, given in a media report with no original NN document or date in the record, and no contract values or volumes are disclosed.
The US$80-90 million 2026 target is an NN business target with no confirmed attainment and no split by customer.
No timing is given for when the 47 machine centers come online or ramp, and no capex or capacity-output figures are disclosed.
follow_up: Retrieve NN's original late-June 2026 press release or filing to confirm the announcement date, the 47 machine centers, the Wuxi location, and the exact wording of the pre-sold and multi-year award claims.
Check NN's subsequent quarterly filings or earnings remarks for named or described customers under the awards and any disclosure of NVIDIA as a customer or end customer.
Check NVIDIA's public filings and supplier disclosures for any mention of NN or liquid-cooling rack suppliers, to see whether NVIDIA itself confirms the supply relationship.
Check whether NN's 2026 new-business target and ramp timing are updated in later filings, to see whether the expansion is progressing as described.
